    "Time-saving automation for routine report generation"

  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve for advanced features like DAX formulas",
    "Occasional difficulty with complex data modeling without dedicated IT support",
    "Cost of licenses for sharing interactive reports within a small team"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Property Administrator likely found Power BI a significant upgrade from Excel for creating detailed reports, especially for visualizing property data. While the initial learning curve for advanced functionalities was challenging, the ability to automate and present data more effectively greatly improved their reporting processes. For a small commercial real estate firm, the value for money was generally good, though licensing costs for widespread sharing could be a consideration."
